purpose: A durable, privacy-aware queue for work that can be resumed across sessions and executed by repository automation.

policy.hosting_constraint: GitHub Pages and other free infrastructure only; no paid host, paid API, or required API key.

tasks.title: Make the execution loop observable and repeatable
checks: execution/queue.json exists and is valid JSON
tasks.completion_evidence: A successful workflow run and an uploaded execution report.

tasks.title: Verify the canonical Living Atlas build inputs
checks: Catalog generation and privacy validation pass
Generated catalog is not committed unless a deliberate reviewed change requires it

tasks.title: Verify the companion application's published routes
checks: The companion repository can be checked out
Its existing Pages build command succeeds
The application, Atlas route, and research route exist in the build output

tasks.title: Diagnose deployment blockers without bypassing repository permissions
checks: Permission or Pages configuration blockers are reported explicitly
No credentials, secrets, or access controls are bypassed
tasks.completion_evidence: A dated diagnostic report with the blocker and the next required action.
